purpose: Measure whether official H=1-encoded real PushT observations after each executed five-action token align with the frozen student and official teacher five-step latent forecasts from the same observation and executed action sequence.

source_freezes.task_rule: Exactly the first two collection tasks in SEEDED_PILOT_FREEZE, in frozen order.

source_alignment.lewm_h1_encode_source: jepa.py:27-42 (pixels CLS embedding; action only adds act_emb)
source_alignment.policy_source: stable_worldmodel/policy.py:347-405 (5 tokens expanded to 25 single-env actions; one buffered action per get_action)
source_alignment.pusht_step_source: stable_worldmodel/envs/pusht/env.py:303-323 (one env.step returns observation after physics stepping)

protocol.evaluation: Reuse the validated one-episode World.evaluate seeded-pilot path, reset seed override 42, native 50-step evaluation budget, goal offset 25, and unchanged student-only native CEM policy. No teacher shadow scoring, training, ranking treatment, or new CEM variant.
protocol.world_model_commits: A packed 10-wide action token is five consecutive 2-D PushT actions. Official horizon=5, receding_horizon=5, action_block=5 expands to 25 env.step calls. Capture post-step pixels only at completed token boundaries.
protocol.observation_encoder: The official LeWM JEPA.encode H=1 path on the same policy-transformed pixels; encode pixels only for emb, with no action token inserted into the current observation latent.
protocol.executed_action_alignment: Re-transform each captured raw env action through the exact official fitted process['action'], pack each five transformed 2-D actions into one 10-wide token, and require max absolute difference <= 1e-5 from the corresponding native t0/t25 solver plan before computing any forecast error.
protocol.forecast_alignment: From the official H=1 latent at each actual solve start, compare five-step official teacher rollout and frozen student rollout on the validated executed packed actions against official H=1 encodings of actual post-step pixels at relative steps 5/10/15/20/25.
protocol.terminal_rule: Only horizons with five committed env.step calls and an actual post-step pixel frame are scored. A terminal/truncated transition at step 25 supplies t0 horizon 5 but may omit the t25 solve; an episode ending between token boundaries reports only earlier complete horizons. Never pad or infer missing observations.
protocol.dataset_reset: Require absent dataset seed column and exactly one dataset World.reset(seed=None) intercepted and forwarded as seed 42, matching SEEDED_PILOT_FREEZE. Native CEM generator seed 42 continues from t0 to t25 without reseeding.
protocol.reserved_holdout: No reserved_holdout task is evaluated, scored, or used for decisions. Official dataset-wide action/proprio/state preprocessing may read those columns, as allowed by the seeded pilot freeze.

must_not_compute_errors_before: initial/solve-start official H=1 pixel encode has shape [1,1,192]
actual observation is present at the exact expected global env step
each available forecast action token matches the corresponding transformed committed actions within 1e-5
student and teacher forecast shapes are [1,N,192] for N actually available complete horizons (N=5 for a complete rollout), and each observed H=1 latent shape is [1,1,192]

claim_boundary: A two-task mechanism diagnostic for real-observation latent target alignment under the controlled seeded protocol. It is not training, a CEM ranking result, an official unseeded baseline, or a closed-loop success claim.
